audit.why: 57.89% over 95 games matches the arc: even at 1 because of the passive ghoul, Cassiopeia's from 2 through the first item, Yorick's once Maiden and two items turn the side lane into his map. Snowball framing is right.

audit.whatIsWrong: Dark Procession is called matchup-defining in the full layer and named as his window in the content layer, but no timer is attached anywhere.
audit.why: Dark Procession is 20/18/16/14/12s and Eulogy of the Isles is 160/130/100s. The cage cooldown is the difference between 'walk up' and 'do not', and Cassiopeia has no dash or blink of her own to leave it with.
audit.corrected: Added the 20s rank-1 cage cooldown, and stated plainly that you have no dash to escape it.

audit.whatIsWrong: Mourning Mist (E) is not named anywhere in either layer, and it is his opener. Separately, the full layer tells you to 'ground his approach' and to 'walk the grounded zone's edge' while the content layer correctly says he has no dash to cancel — the two layers contradict each other.
audit.why: Riot text: Mourning Mist — 'throws a globule of Black Mist that reduces armor, damages, slows and marks enemies. Summoned units gain move speed when moving towards marked targets.' That mark, not a dash, is what brings the ghoul swarm onto you, and it is what you dodge. The kit file's dash flag on Mourning Mist contradicts Riot's own description, which describes a thrown globule, so I did not treat it as a gap-closer.
audit.corrected: Named Mourning Mist as the engage tell throughout, and rewrote the full-layer strings so Miasma is described as a slow and a ghoul-zoning tool rather than a grounding tool.

audit.whatIsWrong: No Grievous Wounds anywhere against a champion who heals off a 6-second auto-reset.
audit.why: Last Rites 'deals bonus damage on his next attack and heals himself' on a 6/5.5/5/4.5/4s cooldown, and it is an auto-attack reset — so it is both his sustain and his burst tell.
audit.corrected: Added Oblivion Orb to the extended-trade want and made the Last Rites wind-up the step-back cue.

edits.before: With Q poison feeding Twin Fang (E) refunds, you chain-cast E and out-DPS Yorick faster than his ghoul autos can trade back.
edits.after: Q poison feeding Twin Fang refunds out-DPSes Yorick, but Last Rites (Q, 6s) is an auto-reset that heals him — step back on the wind-up.

edits.before: Prime with Q poison then spam refunded Twin Fang (E) to out-DPS him and his ghouls in extended trades
edits.after: Prime with Q poison then spam refunded Twin Fang (E), and carry Oblivion Orb — Last Rites heals him every 6s

edits.before: Drop W wall (Dark Procession) to trap you off the wave and farm a free all-in with Maiden up
edits.after: Mark you with Mourning Mist (E) so the ghouls sprint in, then cage you with Dark Procession

edits.before: Ranks in Q and E let you chain refunded Twin Fang through any extended trade, and W slows and poison-zones his ghouls so they can't swarm you.
edits.after: Ranks in Q and E let you chain refunded Twin Fang through any extended trade, and W slows and poison-zones the ghouls Mourning Mist sends at you.

edits.before: Level 1 is even — you have one ability and Yorick's ghoul from his passive gives him a last-hit and trade edge, so don't walk into auto range to throw a Q he can just sidestep behind a ghoul. From level 2 you flip it: prime him with Q poison, then E for a near-free, cooldown-refunded Twin Fang, and your passive move speed keeps you out of his ghoul autos. Use W on the wave to slow him and poison his ghouls rather than to "ground" him — he has no dash to cancel — and never sit in a clump of ghoul autos taking free damage.
edits.after: Level 1 is even — you have one ability and Yorick's passive ghoul gives him a last-hit and trade edge, so do not walk into auto range to throw a Q he sidesteps behind a ghoul. From level 2 you flip it: prime him with Q poison, then E for a near-free refunded Twin Fang, and Serpentine Grace keeps you out of ghoul autos. His opener is Mourning Mist (E) — the mark speeds every ghoul toward you, so treat the globule as the fight starting. Use W to slow him and poison his ghouls rather than to ground him: he has no dash to cancel.

edits.before: This is your lane. With ranks in Q and E your Twin Fang refunds cooldown and chain-casts, so once Yorick is poisoned you out-DPS both him and his ghouls in any extended trade — bait him in, W to slow and poison-zone his ghouls so they can't surround you, then E him down while you kite on your passive speed. At 6 your R is the kill button: stun him the moment he commits and you delete him before Maiden of the Mist can arrive. Punish every shove he makes to push for his Maiden timer.
edits.after: This is your lane. With ranks in Q and E your Twin Fang refunds and chain-casts, so a poisoned Yorick loses every extended trade — bait him in, W to slow and poison-zone the ghouls, then fang him down while you kite. Never fight next to a wall: Dark Procession is 20 seconds at rank 1 and you own no dash to leave the cage with. At 6 your R is the kill button — stun him the moment he commits and delete him before Maiden of the Mist arrives. Punish every shove to push for his Maiden timer.

edits.before: A DPS check he fails — poison every step-up, ground his approach, and E-spam him off the wave.
edits.after: A DPS check he fails — poison every step-up, dodge Mourning Mist, and E-spam him off the wave.

edits.before: Poison the wave, ground the approach, and out-DPS the brawl he never starts. Every commit starts with one question: is Dark Procession (Cage) down?
edits.after: Poison the wave, dodge the mark, and out-DPS the brawl he never starts. Every commit starts with one question: is Dark Procession down?

edits.before: Q-poison his last-hit, E twice on the poison timer, drop W as he steps at you, and walk the grounded zone's edge while the fangs finish the math.
edits.after: Q-poison his last-hit, E twice on the poison timer, and kite on Serpentine Grace — he has no dash, so W is for slowing the ghouls, not grounding him.

edits.before: Spamming E without poison until your mana bar dies — and then standing in Dark Procession (Cage) range with Miasma on cooldown.
edits.after: Spamming E without poison until your mana bar dies — or fighting inside a Dark Procession cage with no dash of your own to leave it.

edits.before: - Yorick Dark Procession (Cage): matchup-defining — The cage traps you with the ghoul swarm — sidestep or break it instantly. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your W Miasma like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Yorick Dark Procession: matchup-defining — 20s at rank 1, and you have no dash to leave the cage; never fight beside a wall. - Mourning Mist is the 12s mark that sends the ghouls at you. - Last Rites is a 6s auto-reset that heals him.
